notes: Official MPSC archive and both original notices; source and application-portal robots.txt each allow collection. Archive lists upload/notification date 15 September, while both PDFs are dated 11 September. Neither establishes an application opening date.

Peon advert 26/2026-27 says three posts and closes 13 October 2026 at 4 PM; LDC advert 25/2026-27 says four posts and closes 12 October at 4 PM. Both are direct-recruitment examinations with no published exam venue in retained notices.
Both require Mizo Language Proficiency qualifying test or specified Class-X/MIL exemption. 2024 MPSC notice confirms rule and disqualification outcome but gives no numerical pass mark or CEFR level.

Neither notice states citizenship or general domicile criteria. International-applicant eligibility, cited recruitment rules, precise opening date, fees and live application form need founder review. Other Mizoram authorities and notices remain coverage gaps.
